explication: Pelican Panel is a web control panel for game servers isolated in Docker and managed through Wings. The main operator workflow is to configure nodes and server definitions, create/manage server instances in the panel, then view console and resource information while Wings performs daemon-side operations. The repository also exposes client and application APIs, OAuth sign-in, and administration for supporting resources. Several domain models are included because they are central modules; unsampled API and administration internals are grouped by their existing source directories, and their detailed call paths are not asserted.
